subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & compliance recap / next steps
messages:
From: David Lopez <david.lopez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync follow-up: SOC 2 artefacts and retention questions

Thanks for the walkthrough today, Marissa. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can move this to procurement: 

Pain / context:
- ACME Health is preparing for an internal audit and wants to confirm third-party controls for PHI-adjacent workloads. 
- Key concerns: SOC 2 report availability, retention policies for audit logs, proof of pen testing, and DPA clauses around data residency and deletion.

Asks:
1) Can you send the most recent SOC 2 Type II (2026) and a short summary of scope?
2) What is Redwood's default audit log retention and can it be customized per customer?
3) Do you provide pen test reports or a redacted executive summary we can share with our InfoSec team?
4) DPA — are there standard EU data residency options and appendix for deletion requests?

Appreciate a concise recap and next steps (we'd like to present to procurement this week).

-David
David Lopez
Security Program Manager
ACME Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Lopez <david.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync follow-up: SOC 2 artefacts and retention questions

Thanks for the note and for the time today, David — great to meet you and the ACME InfoSec team. Below is a concise recap from our call and clear next steps so procurement has what it needs. If I missed anything, flag it and I'll update.

Summary of what we heard (pain/goals):
- You need SOC 2 Type II evidence that covers our hosted inference platform and the console (covers data handling for inference requests, key management integrations).
- Audit log retention + exportability is required for 12+ months for your compliance team; ability to snapshot/export logs for audits is critical.
- DPA: you require explicit deletion (right-to-erasure) processes and options for EU data residency (we discussed routing to EU region/right to pin model serving).
- Pen test evidence: ACME needs an executive summary or redacted report to satisfy third-party risk reviews.

What Redwood can provide (quick answers):
- SOC 2: We can share our SOC 2 Type II report (2026) covering the hosted API and control environment. See attached: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf.
- Audit logs: Default retention is 90 days in hosted by default, with configurable retention up to 3 years on Dedicated/Private. We can provide a retention matrix and export of logs (CSV/JSON) on request; attaching a sample matrix.
- Pen test: We can provide a redacted pen test executive summary and test coverage statement (attached: pen_test_summary_2026.pdf). Full unredacted reports are available under NDA.
- DPA & residency: We have a standard EU Appendix and an addendum for data residency controls; we also support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) on Dedicated and Private.

Action items / next steps (owner / ETA):
1) I'll send the SOC 2 PDF, pen-test summary, and retention matrix (attached) — DONE (attachments included).
2) Neha to confirm exact audit-log export format and provide a short how-to (Neha, EOD Tue).
3) Rishi (Solutions) to outline configuration options for Dedicated and Private deployments and high-level pricing impact if ACME requests 12+ month retention or EU pinned serving (Rishi, Wed EOD).
4) David / ACME to confirm whether redacted reports are sufficient or if a full report under NDA is required (ACME, Wed).
5) If procurement is happy, we can route a DPA + EU Appendix and a PO/quote within 48 hours of confirmation (Marissa / Sales Ops).

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf, retention_matrix_ACME-request.xlsx, pen_test_summary_2026.pdf

Thanks — I'll also drop links to the relevant compliance pages for your legal team below.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: David Lopez <david.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync follow-up: SOC 2 artefacts and retention questions

Hi David — following up with technical details on audit logs and export formats.

Audit log facts:
- Types captured: request metadata (timestamp, request id, model id, token counts), routing decisions, key rotation events, and admin console actions.
- Format: exportable as newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) or CSV; we also provide a pre-filtered CSV for audit windows.
- Retention: hosted default = 90 days; Dedicated / Private configurable up to 36 months. Retention beyond default incurs storage fees; we'll outline pricing.
- Snapshots: we can produce point-in-time exports for specific date ranges and provide a signed manifest for chain-of-custody.

Technical next steps (Neha / Rishi):
- Neha to share a sample ndjson export and brief how-to for creating snapshots (attached retention_matrix_ACME-request.xlsx includes sample commands) — ETA Tue EOD.
- Rishi to prepare a brief about Dedicated configuration options for 12+ month retention and EU pinned serving, plus T-shirt pricing impact — ETA Wed EOD.

If ACME wants the export demonstrated, happy to run a short remote session with your engineers.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Marissa / Neha — this is perfect, thank you. Redacted SOC2 + pen test summary should be sufficient for our initial vendor review. A couple of clarifying items: 
- Can you confirm whether logs include user-identifying metadata by default (we discussed token-level truncation)?
- For the retention pricing, a ballpark monthly delta helps procurement.

We'd like to schedule a short checkpoint next week (30 minutes) with procurement + InfoSec to review the docs and the DPA appendix. Please propose a couple of times.

-David
